heading: Shareable Campaign Pages
content: Mobile-first pages with your story, photo, live progress bar, and simple ways to donate money or drop off what's needed.

heading: One-Tap Push Requests
content: Managers request cash contributions directly from supporters who've already said yes.

heading: Donor Pool (CRM)
content: Track supporters, their consent status, and their giving history — in cash or in kind — in one place.

heading: Cash & In-Kind Support
content: Collect money and coordinate donated items on the same Campaign — one place for community giving.

heading: Real Receipts & Updates
content: Every donor gets an instant receipt and a progress update after they give.

heading: Built-In Security
content: Changia never sees or stores your mobile-money PIN. Every transaction is verified before it counts.
